description: This file defines the ClassLoader class for Composer's autoloading mechanism, implementing PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap autoloading strategies. It manages class-to-file mappings, prefix directories, fallback directories, and handles dynamic class loading.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Implements a versatile autoloader supporting PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap strategies, used for dynamically loading PHP classes based on namespace or class name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClassLoader with an optional vendor directory.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the autoloader with PHP's SPL autoload stack.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the autoloader from PHP's SPL autoload stack.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads the specified class by finding its file and including it.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Finds the filesystem path for a given class name.

methods.name: setUseIncludePath
methods.description: Enables or disables searching the include path for class files.

methods.name: getUseIncludePath
methods.description: Returns whether include path searching is enabled.

methods.name: addClassMap
methods.description: Merges additional class-to-file mappings into the class map.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds PSR-0 directory mappings for a namespace prefix.

methods.name: addPsr4
methods.description: Adds PSR-4 directory mappings for a namespace.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces PSR-0 prefix directories for a given prefix.

methods.name: setPsr4
methods.description: Replaces PSR-4 directory mappings for a namespace.

methods.name: setClassMap
methods.description: Sets the entire class map.

methods.name: setClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Sets whether class map is authoritative.

methods.name: isClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Checks if class map is authoritative.

methods.name: setApcuPrefix
methods.description: Sets the APCu cache prefix.

methods.name: getApcuPrefix
methods.description: Gets the APCu cache prefix.

methods.name: getPrefixes
methods.description: Retrieves all PSR-0 prefix mappings.

methods.name: getPrefixesPsr4
methods.description: Retrieves all PSR-4 prefix mappings.

methods.name: getFallbackDirs
methods.description: Retrieves fallback directories for PSR-0.

methods.name: getFallbackDirsPsr4
methods.description: Retrieves fallback directories for PSR-4.

methods.name: getClassMap
methods.description: Returns current class-to-file mappings.

methods.name: getRegisteredLoaders
methods.description: Returns all registered loader instances keyed by vendor directory.
